chunks: All things small or great have been written down.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that every small and great deed is written down in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase underscores the precision of the *Kitab* (Divine Record), where even the smallest actions are weighed with exactitude, reflecting the concept of *Adl* (Divine Justice). It serves as a reminder that no deed is too insignificant to be recorded, encouraging believers to maintain constant mindfulness (*Muraqabah*) in both public and private spheres.
